title: What Does "Var det bra så?" Mean in Swedish? | Café Phrase | SvenskaVardag
text:
You've heard it at every Swedish counter: "Var det bra så?" ☕ Latte only, or latte AND kladdkaka? Answer in Swedish in the comments!

📝 "Var det bra så?"
↳ Is that all? (not "Was it good?")

🎓 Ja, det var bra så, tack. = Yes, that's all, thanks.
Nej, jag tar en bit kladdkaka också. = No, I'll also have a slice of chocolate cake.
